instructions.question: What emotional attitude does the poster of this Bosnian tweet convey: positive, neutral or negative?
instructions.rule: Pick negative only for sincere distress (sadness, heartbreak, exhaustion that hurts), hostility, contempt, insults or disgust toward people, or harmful news. Pick positive for warmth, affection, flirting, enjoyment, agreement or praise, and for news or promos about constructive, festive or beneficial things. Matter-of-fact anecdotes, curious questions, mild comic exaggerations about one's own body or day, sayings, quotes, lyrics, schedules and plain shop ads are neutral. A laughing emoticon alone does not make a text positive.

neutral.what: No clear feeling: everyday anecdotes, curious or puzzled questions, mild comic exaggerations about oneself, sayings, quotes, lyrics, check-ins, schedules, shop ads, scores and flat headlines.
examples: Ne mogu više ovih čajeva,bešika će da mi eksplodira. (Can't take more teas, my bladder will explode.)
Kako objasniti to da neko zivi u Njemackoj godinama i pise StuDgart????????? (How to explain someone living in Germany for years writing StuDgart?)
15 minuta trazim fen koji mi se nalazi ispod stola (15 minutes looking for the hairdryer that was under the table)
Bazar će biti održan 30. novembra u Katoličkom školskom centru u Sarajevu (The bazaar will be held on 30 November...)
neutral.cues: ?, zašto (why), ko normalan (who in their right mind), i ostale misterije (and other mysteries), I'm at, pogledajte ponudu (see the offer), večeras u (tonight at), mp3, haha
neutral.not_for: Sincere suffering or contempt for people is negative. Clear affection, enjoyment or constructive news is positive.

positive.what: Warmth, affection, flirting, enjoyment, agreement or support in banter, praise, or news and promos about constructive, festive, cultural, sporting or beneficial things.
examples: @rooster_62 hahaha tako je! Nema predaje. (hahaha that's right! No surrender.)
zaljubi se u mene, hitno mi je (fall in love with me, it's urgent)
Danas počinje skijanje na Vlašiću (Skiing starts today on Vlašić)
Koja gotiva danas prva dva casa na sekciji, i sad peti nemam ma ee uzivanjeee (What fun today, no fifth class, enjoyment!)
positive.cues: volim (I love), uživanje (enjoyment), gotivim (I like), tako je (that's right), nedostajala (missed you), bravo, <3, :), počinje (starts), podrška (support), nagrađena (awarded)
positive.not_for: Jokes, anecdotes or questions that merely include haha, :P or xD are neutral. Sad content ending in :) is negative.

negative.what: Sincere sadness, heartbreak, painful exhaustion, anger, hate, contempt or insults toward people, disgust, or headlines about crime, scandal, conflict or harm.
examples: neprospavane noci ++ (sleepless nights)
I opet ko god te spomene mene srce puca. Ali ne dam da se to prmjeti :) (Whenever someone mentions you my heart breaks, but I hide it)
Ti ljudi koju napadaju druge kad kasne, a kad oni kasne to je sasvim ok. (Those people who attack others for being late, but it's fine when they're late.)
Incident u Trebinju (Incident in Trebinje)
negative.cues: jebem (f***), mrzim (I hate), fuj (yuck), glupan (idiot), srce puca (heart breaks), tuga (sadness), placem (I cry), dotukla (wore me out), -_-, :(
negative.not_for: Light self-mockery, odd observations about one's own day or body, and puzzled questions are neutral.
